Rebind this requirement to the P3-14/P3-12 assertions of assertions-recette.json (and to P3-20 only for the message's visual rendering), and review the scope mapping of all 95 documentary requirements so that a state whose expected value is a behavioural rule is not attached to the visual-conformity scope.

Filter the Figma property projection so that only attributes observable on the delivered surface become assertions, and either drop the vector/blend node attributes or reclassify them as non-asserted source context with an explicit note, so VISUAL_COMPARE has a dischargeable scope.

Either add the baseline test files of every MODIFY target to write_scope with an explicit ADAPT test obligation and a stated conservation expectation, or amend schema-et-ecritures.md to state that the old calculation tests are not revised and explain how the replaced duration contract stays proven.
